outcome: Time from start of induction to any delivery
cohort: 138 pregnant women at or beyond 37 weeks gestation undergoing labor induction with misoprostol vaginal insert
finding: The time from induction to delivery with MVI was similar for both standard (MVI-24) and adjusted (MVI-10) criteria, but there was a non-significant trend towards a lower cesarean delivery rate with the adjusted criteria.
mod_finding: While not statistically significant, the cesarean delivery rate was lower in the MVI-10 group compared to the MVI-24 group.
